name: QUBICC high-resolution ICON simulation (coarse-grained)
size_as_stated: 40 d evenly distributed across four months: November 2004, January, April, July 2005; 2.3 million training samples, 260k validation samples, 1.9 million test samples for shortwave and 4.2 million test samples for longwave radiation
resolution: 5 km horizontal grid spacing, 191 vertical levels, coarse-grained to 80 km and 47 levels
